row:
Looking to stop living in pain, being overweight, or even become an athlete? Or, perhaps you are a Personal Trainer, Massage Therapist, or Nutritionist, etc. looking for continuing education to up your skill set.. Either way, you're in the right place! 
I'll be covering subjects from nutrition for weight management to nutrition for tapering and recovery; beginner self care to advanced manual therapy techniques; from starting a workout program to sport specific training modalities and considerations; and so much more...
I'm Marshall! I've been a fitness professional since 1997! I am a Licensed Massage Therapist, Corrective Exercise Specialist, Nutritionist, TRX instructor, and more... I have almost 3 decades of success stories from weight loss clients to Iron Man athletes, clients who had frozen shoulders or spondylitis who's symptoms went away to people who physically aged backwards due to my health advice. And, now I'm here to share my techniques with you!
